title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 11 in F major

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a third every bar.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in F major (Bass); Subject in F major (Alto)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: the opening of the subject.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Soprano); Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in D minor (Bass)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G minor (Bass); Subject in G minor (Alto)
